name: webroot-install-deploy-fields
base_config:
account:
  email: ops@example.com
  accept_tos: true
dns:
  provider: cloudflare
certificates:
  - name: example
    domains:
      - example.com
    challenge: webroot
    webroot_path: public
    install:
      key_file: deploy/live/privkey.pem
      fullchain_file: deploy/live/fullchain.pem
    deploy:
      - name: edge
        type: copy
        directory: deploy/edge
    hooks:
      post_install:
        - echo install
      post_deploy:
        - echo deploy

name: dns-credentials-derive-env

name: dns-credentials-derive-oraclecloud
base_config:
account:
  email: ops@example.com
  accept_tos: true
dns:
  provider: oraclecloud
  region: ap-singapore-1
  credentials:
    compartment_id: ocid1.compartment.oc1..example
    tenancy_id: ocid1.tenancy.oc1..example
    user_id: ocid1.user.oc1..example
    fingerprint: aa:bb:cc
    private_key_file: .oracle/oci.pem
certificates:
  - name: example
    domains:
      - example.com

name: named-dns-provider-selected-per-certificate
base_config:
account:
  email: ops@example.com
  accept_tos: true
dns:
  env:
    GLOBAL_SHARED: enabled
dns_providers:
  cf-prod:
    provider: cloudflare
    credentials:
      api_token: cf-token
  aliyun-cn:
    provider: alicloud-cn
    credentials:
      access_key: aliyun-ak
      secret_key: aliyun-sk
certificates:
  - name: example
    domains:
      - example.com
    dns:
      provider_ref: aliyun-cn
